name: elizaos-plugin-devx-tokencheck
description: ElizaOS plugin: DevX Token Check rug/honeypot verdict (safe/caution/danger) before swaps on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Robinhood Chain and Solana. $0.01 USDC per check via x402 from the agent wallet; free demo tokens. By Made by DevX.
author: Made by DevX <madebydevx@gmail.com> (https://madebydevx.com)

EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Agent wallet key (shared with plugin-evm). Pays $0.01 USDC on Base per paid check. Optional.

DEVX_TOKENCHECK_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Separate key just for Token Check payments (overrides EVM_PRIVATE_KEY). Optional.

DEVX_TOKENCHECK_MAX_PRICE_USDC.description: Max USDC per check the plugin will sign for. Default 0.01.

DEVX_TOKENCHECK_DEMO_ONLY.description: Never pay; only free demo tokens. Default false.

DEVX_TOKENCHECK_GUARD_ACTIONS.description: Comma-separated swap action names to guard, e.g. EVM_SWAP_TOKENS.

DEVX_TOKENCHECK_GUARD_BLOCK_ON.description: Verdicts that block a guarded swap. Default danger.

DEVX_TOKENCHECK_GUARD_FAIL_CLOSED.description: Block guarded swaps when no verdict is available. Default false.

DEVX_TOKENCHECK_DEFAULT_CHAIN.description: Chain when none is given. Default base.
